Product Management
GraphQL

The Opportunity


RoaDo helps shippers and logistics teams run domestic and cross-border freight on one connected platform. As a Product Manager, you'll take charge of one area of that platform. Depending on business needs at the time you join, it could be load planning, carrier sourcing and spot bidding, shipment visibility, our AI-driven control tower, digital proof of delivery, freight billing, or our export-import (EXIM) workflows. You'll partner with engineers, operations teams, and enterprise clients to turn real logistics problems into products that deliver clear business results.


Your Responsibilities

• Set the product direction and quarterly priorities for your area, and see them through to delivery

• Take full ownership of how users get work done in your module, from first sketch to everyday adoption

• Strengthen how RoaDo connects with the outside world: client ERPs, transporter systems, GPS and telematics devices, shipping lines, forwarders, customs brokers, and port terminals

• Give customers a single view of their international shipments, from factory gate to port, across the sea or air leg, and on to final delivery

• Spend regular time with exporters, importers, transporters, forwarders, and finance teams to find where work breaks down and decide what to fix first

• Write detailed requirement documents that leave little room for interpretation, and stay close to the engineering team through each sprint

• Choose the right success measures, such as usage, turnaround time, port dwell, and cost per shipment, and report on them consistently


What We're Looking For

• 5 to 7 years in product management, including at least 2 years running a B2B software product with full accountability

• Solid knowledge of road freight in India, both full-truckload and part-load, including how loads are planned, how transporters are selected, how trips are tracked, and how freight bills are settled

• Practical understanding of the truckload lifecycle: placing orders with transporters, monitoring trip milestones, handling waiting charges, and closing payments

• Good knowledge of export-import operations, including space booking, container handling at CFS and ICD, port movement, customs filing, and coordination with shipping lines and forwarders

• Comfort with core trade documents and terms such as Bill of Lading, Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, Incoterms, and demurrage and detention charges

• Experience with exception alerts, live visibility, or control-tower style products will set you apart

• Able to read API docs and work through integration details with engineers, including GPS and SIM-based tracking, container tracking feeds, webhooks, and ERP connections

• A data-driven mindset: you can estimate the size of a problem, pick the metric that matters, and build a persuasive case from numbers

• Strong written communication and the ability to align engineering and business teams around a spec


How You Use AI

We give real weight to this. RoaDo PMs are expected to use AI as part of their everyday toolkit.

• You regularly use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to analyse data and find patterns in product logs, customer tickets, and call notes

• You can quickly build a working prototype or demo to test an idea before engineering time is spent

• You use AI to speed up research, produce first drafts of specs, and challenge your own assumptions early

• You think about how AI can change what our product does for customers, such as reading trade documents automatically or predicting delays, and not only how it speeds up building


Bonus Points

• Background in multi-tenant enterprise SaaS

• Hands-on experience with freight forwarding, 3PL, or shipping line software, or with platforms like ICEGATE, PCS, or ULIP

• Exposure to multimodal freight across road, rail, sea, and air

• Working knowledge of Mixpanel, Metabase, Jira, or similar tools

About

While we’re rooting for them, we’re building what comes after. We're based in New York and backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, 186 Ventures, Reach Capital and many more. We raised an oversubscribed seed round from some of the best investors in Silicon Valley. Our team includes AI product leaders from companies like Google, physician executives from major health systems, and more.


About the Role

We're looking for a Product Manager, AI to join our team in our Bangalore office. With how AI models are evolving, we don't believe in traditional roles. Whereas in an old-school company you may write long PRDs and hand off to designers and engineering, and spend weeks in back and forths trying to get 1 feature approved, we operate completely differently. Here's what your day-to-day may look like:

  • Instead of writing PRD's, you'll build prototypes.
  • You'll be responsible for prioritizing which pain points to solve, outlining how we should solve them, and designing the user experience yourself as well (with the power of our AI design tools).
  • At any given time, you may be using AI coding tools and AI design tools to parallel track prototypes for 5-10 large features.
  • Rather than waiting weeks for approvals, features you prototype will be handed off to engineering and be shipped into production an average of 2-5 days.
  • You will talk to customers and research the domain deeply - becoming an expert for the team on domain knowledge and product strategy.


Requirements

  • Prior experience working as a Product Manager at a venture backed startup.
  • Either (A) strong experience professionally as a software engineer, or (B) exceptional UX design skills. Must be multifaceted in one of these 2 ways.

Associate Product Manager

at GeoIQ

Posted by Jancy Challam

Bengaluru (Bangalore) · 1 - 3 years · Raised funding · Posted 3 Nov 2026

Product Management
Product owner

Position Overview:

We are building a new retail merchandising platform on top of that data. It answers what to stock, how much, and in which store, combining sales, catalogue, and customer data with GeoIQ’s location attributes at retail scale: thousands of stores, tens of thousands of SKUs, decisions made weekly.


As the product manager on this platform, you will own how those decisions reach the people who make them: category managers, planners and store operations teams. The models are being built alongside the product, so you will decide what gets built, in what order, and how its output fits into a buyer’s weekly planning cycle. You will work every day with data science and engineering, and what you ship changes what a store actually orders.


Responsibilities:

  • Own one or more platform modules (demand forecasting, assortment planning, replenishment, new-launch allocation) from problem definition through to adoption.
  • Spend time with merchandisers, category managers and store teams to understand how buying and replenishment decisions are made today, often in spreadsheets, and where that process breaks.
  • Write specs that data science and engineering can build from: the decision being supported, its inputs, the business rules and constraints (minimum display quantities, pack sizes, warehouse reserves, brand rules), and what a good output looks like.
  • Design the workflows that let planners act on model output with confidence: recommendation screens, overrides, explanations and exception queues.
  • Define success metrics with the business (sell-through, stockouts, inventory turns, forecast accuracy, recommendation acceptance) and set up pilot-versus-control rollouts to measure them.
  • Run pilots with store clusters and categories, gather feedback, and decide what changes before a module scales to the full network.
  • Lead discovery when the platform extends to new brands and markets, each with its own data, supply chain and planning process.
  • Keep the roadmap, priorities and trade-offs clear to merchandising, category, supply chain and leadership teams.


Expectations:

  • Work experience: 2–5 years, with at least 2 years in product management
  • Prior experience taking a product from problem definition to adoption by real users
  • Comfortable with data: able to write SQL, work through a spreadsheet model, and read a model evaluation or A/B test result
  • Clear written communication, including specs that engineers and data scientists can build from without a meeting
  • Understanding of how ML-driven products differ: probabilistic outputs, accuracy limits, and the need for user overrides
  • Experience with B2B, internal tools or data-heavy products will be an added advantage
  • Experience in retail, e-commerce, merchandising, supply chain or inventory planning will be an added advantage
  • Prior experience as an analyst, engineer or data scientist will be an added advantage


Join us early and own the product that decides what thousands of stores stock each week, working directly with the merchants who use it and the team that builds it.

What you'll own

You'll lead product for the entire NoiseFit app, not a slice of it. That means:

Core Experience

  • End-to-end app experience across health, fitness, wellness, engagement, and connected device features.
  • Activation and onboarding in the first seven days that determine whether a user stays.
  • Daily habit loops—the features and nudges that bring someone back every morning.
  • Health intelligence layer—turning raw sensor data into insights users can actually act upon.
  • AI/ML-driven personalization through contextual coaching, adaptive goals, and smarter recommendations.


Growth & Business

  • Retention architecture including streaks, challenges, community and reward systems.
  • Monetization opportunities including subscriptions, premium experiences and ecosystem partnerships.
  • Experimentation culture through A/B testing, funnel analysis and rapid iteration.
  • Device-to-app experience connecting what happens on the wrist with what happens on the phone.
  • Cross-functional leadership across Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, and Hardware teams.


Who we're looking for

We're looking for someone with 8+ years of consumer product management experience and a proven record of building and scaling B2C mobile products.

More importantly, we're looking for someone who:

  • Thinks about user emotion as much as user flow.
  • Is deeply comfortable with product analytics using tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase, or similar.
  • Ships fast, experiments constantly, and makes data-backed decisions.

Title: Senior Product Manager

 

Location: Mumbai

 

Job Type: Full-Time, Work From Office

 

About Us

Traya is an Indian direct-to-consumer hair care brand platform that provides a holistic treatment for consumers dealing with hair loss. The Company provides personalized consultations that help determine the root cause of hair fall among individuals, along with a range of hair care products that are curated from a combination of Ayurveda, Allopathy, and Nutrition. Traya's secret lies in the power of diagnosis. Our unique platform diagnoses the patient’s hair & health history, to identify the root cause behind hair fall and delivers customized hair kits to them right at their doorstep. We have a strong adherence system in place via medically trained hair coaches and proprietary tech, where we guide the customer across their hair growth journey, and help them stay on track. Traya is founded by Saloni Anand, a techie turned-marketeer and Altaf Saiyed, a Stanford Business School alumnus.

 

Our Vision:

Traya was created with a global vision to create awareness around hair loss, de-stigmatise it while empathizing with the customers that it has an emotional and psychological impact.

Most importantly, to combine 3 different sciences (Ayurveda, Allopathy and Nutrition) to create the perfect holistic solution for hair loss patients.

 

The Founders:

Founded by Saloni Anand, a techie-turned-marketeer and Altaf Saiyed, a Stanford Business School alumnus.


About Product Team:

Our Product Team works closely with the Business and Engineering teams to ensure we develop the right technology solutions for customer experience, acquisition, and retention. If you're passionate about making a difference in people's lives through cutting-edge product strategies, this role is for you.

Traya web and app are at the heart of user acquisition and retention. These platforms enable the user to get their hair loss diagnosed, purchase the hair care kit, get hair coach support, access features that help them remain consistent with their routine, and achieve great hair. The product management team at Traya is seeking a highly motivated, data driven Product Manager to drive the consumer-facing web and app products.


A successful Product Manager must have exceptional user insights and research background, data skills, strong analytical abilities, relationship-building and communication skills across cross-functional teams, an ability to work under tight deadlines, a track record of delivering results, and be an independent self-starter.

 

Responsibilities:

 

●Acquisition/ Retention Strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive retention/acquisition strategy for our mobile app, utilizing data-driven insights to identify opportunities for improvement.

●User Experience Enhancement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers and developers, to enhance the overall user experience within the app, ensuring use in seamless navigation and engagement.

●Feature Development: Lead the ideation, planning, and execution of new features and functionalities within the app that contribute to improved user retention. Analytics and Insights: Utilize analytics tools and customer feedback to monitor user behaviour, identify pain points, and propose data-driven solutions to increase user engagement and retention.

● A/B Testing: Implement A/B testing methodologies to evaluate the performance of different features and strategies, optimizing for user retention metrics. Communication and Collaboration: Effectively communicate product initiatives and updates to cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with overall company objectives.

●Competitor Analysis: Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging technologies to inform product decisions and maintain a competitive edge.

●KPI Monitoring: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) related to user retention and regularly monitor, report, and analyse these metrics to track the success of implemented strategies.

 

Qualifications:

 

● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field.

● Proven experience as a Product Manager with a focus on improving user retention in a consumer company.

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and trends.

● Experience with mobile app development and a solid understanding of user experience principles.

● Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

● Familiarity with A/B testing methodologies and a data-driven

decision-making approach.

● Proactive mindset with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

● Knowledge of agile development methodologies is a plus.

Define requirements for AI assistants, intelligent agents and AI-powered business workflows.

Work with the Head of AI to translate model capabilities, technical dependencies and constraints into product specifications.

Define expected AI behaviour, business rules, exception handling and measurable business outcomes.

Identify where AI is appropriate versus deterministic workflows and conventional business logic.

Validate delivered features against requirements and lead functional and user acceptance testing.

Identify delivery risks, technical trade-offs and dependencies to ensure timely, high-quality releases.

Prototype or validate product concepts when required.

5. Product Strategy & Market Intelligence

Identify new product opportunities across financial services.

Evaluate customer needs, competitive products and emerging AI capabilities.

Develop industry-specific use cases and product propositions.

Collaborate with leadership to align product investments with customer demand, business objectives and long-term product strategy.

Product Manager – AI/GenAI

Our AI platform that lets people ask questions of their enterprise data in natural language and get trustworthy answers. The hard part isn't the model — it's the fit between what the product can genuinely do and what customers actually need, over data that is never as clean as anyone hopes. We're hiring a Product Manager to own that fit: to do the detailed thinking on customer pain, competitive landscape, and where the technology is going, and to turn it into a sharp, defensible product proposition and roadmap. You'll work closely with the CTO (who currently carries this thinking) and become the person who owns the depth beneath it.


What you'll own

• Proposition & positioning. Take fuzzy capability and turn it into a clear, honest, defensible articulation of what Jiva is, who it's for, and why it wins. Kill the gap between what's sold and what's deliverable.

• Customer intelligence (within the current structure). Sales and Delivery own the customer relationship today; you build the customer picture through them —mining PoC post-mortems, win/loss, readiness audits, sales-call notes, and Delivery's ground truth. Extract real jobs-to-be-done, separate stated wants from underlying pain, and bring a synthesized customer voice into the room. Over time, earn a path to direct customer contact — but you'll start by getting more 

out of the signal the field teams already carry than anyone does today.

• Competitive & technology intelligence. Track the space — RAG, text-to-SQL, tabular/relational foundation models, agentic systems, the commercial players — and synthesize it into product direction. Know what's real and what's marketing.

• Requirements & roadmap. Translate the above into crisp requirements and a prioritized roadmap, in partnership with Engineering. Make the trade-offs explicit.

• Sales & Delivery enablement. Own the "what we can honestly promise" story so field teams stop overselling and start qualifying. You are the source of truth on capability boundaries.


Must-haves

• 5+ years in B2B / enterprise product management, ideally on data, analytics, AI/ML, or platform products.

• Demonstrated ability to frame a proposition — you can show us a product or feature where you turned raw capability into a positioning that won customers. Portfolio evidence, not a claim.

• Technical fluency in AI/data. You understand RAG, LLMs, text-to-SQL, and data quality well enough to judge feasibility vs. hype and to earn engineers' respect. You don't need to code; you need to reason.

• Customer discovery skill — and the resourcefulness to apply it 

indirectly. You've run structured discovery and can distinguish what customers say from what they need. Just as important here: you can extract sharp customer insight secondhand — through sales and delivery teams, deal histories, 

and product usage — because you won't have direct customer access on day one.

• Evidence-driven and structured. You validate before you evangelize. Strong written thinker — you can put a proposition on one page and defend it.


Nice-to-have

• Exposure to NL→SQL, semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or enterprise data governance.

• 0-to-1 or turnaround experience — comfort building the function, not just running it.

• Experience selling into or building for regulated / data-sensitive enterprises

Product Manager / Associate Product Manager


Turn messy real-world problems into simple products.

AbleCredit builds software for complex enterprise workflows where AI, APIs, business rules, human decisions, and real-world operations have to work together reliably. We care about building products that work in production - not just in demos. Our customers don't arrive with clean product requirements. They have operational problems involving people, policies, existing systems, edge cases, and workflows built over years. Product at AbleCredit means understanding that complexity deeply and turning it into reusable, simple product capabilities.


What You'll Own?

• Spend time with customers and internal teams to understand workflows, constraints, and the real problem behind requests.

• Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear product requirements, user journeys, and measurable outcomes.

• Work closely with engineering and design from discovery through rollout rather than handing off specifications.

• Prioritize based on customer impact, product strategy, effort, risk, and reuse across customers.

• Define success metrics and evaluate whether shipped products actually improve the workflow.

• Own launches, feedback loops, adoption, and iteration after release.

• Identify patterns across customer requests and turn them into reusable platform capabilities instead of one-off customizations.

• Maintain clarity on what we are building, why we are building it, and what we deliberately are not building.


What We're Looking For?

• 1-5 years of product, engineering, analytics, consulting, operations, or adjacent experience; level will be calibrated to experience.

• Strong problem decomposition and structured thinking.

• Ability to understand technical systems, APIs, data flows, and constraints well enough to work deeply with engineers.

• Excellent written and verbal communication.

• Comfort speaking with customers and asking detailed questions until the underlying workflow is understood.

• Bias toward evidence, prototypes, and shipped outcomes rather than process for its own sake.

• Ability to operate with ambiguity and make sensible trade-offs.


Nice to Have

• Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, workflow products, fintech, or AI-assisted products.

• Technical background or prior engineering experience.

• Experience working with APIs, integrations, analytics, or operational products.

• Experience taking a product from discovery through adoption.


How Product Works Here?

Product managers are expected to understand the problem deeply, not act as ticket routers. The best solution may be a new feature, a platform primitive, a workflow change, an API, or deciding not to build something. Success is measured by customer and product outcomes, not PRD volume.

Founding Product Engineer, Developer Adoption

at Signett

Posted by Kartik Hegde

Remote only · 2 - 10 years · ₹25L - ₹50L / yr · Remote only · Posted 11 Sep 2026

Fullstack Developer
TypeScript
Web browsers
Product Management

The web is about to gain a second interface


Today, websites are designed for people. Agents must interpret pages, hunt for controls, and imitate clicks to accomplish anything.


We believe that will change. Websites will expose their capabilities directly to agents: structured, testable interfaces that work alongside the human experience. WebMCP is an early step toward that future. Signett is building the developer platform around it.


Our goal is to make creating an excellent agent interface as normal as building an API or testing a user interface.


The foundational product already exists. Signett has a public TypeScript library, documentation, benchmarks, real-world integrations, a website, and a Chrome extension. You would not be joining to turn a slide deck into an MVP. You would be joining to discover what makes a promising product become something developers genuinely adopt.


See it at signett.ai.


The opportunity


You would be Signett’s first hire and would have unusual ownership over the product’s direction.

Your job is to run one loop repeatedly:

  1. Find an external developer or team with a real reason to make its website agent-ready.
  2. Work inside its codebase and ship the integration.
  3. Identify what made the process difficult.
  4. Fix that friction yourself—in the library, documentation, testing tools, or extension.
  5. Publish what you learned so the next integration becomes easier.

You will move between engineering, product discovery, developer experience, and early distribution. There will be no handoff between those functions because, initially, you are the person connecting them.

The work could help establish how developers build and test agent interfaces for the web. It could also reveal that our present assumptions are wrong. Either outcome requires someone who cares more about finding the truth than defending the existing product.


The first 90 days


The initial targets are deliberately concrete:

  • Five external teams attempt the 30-minute integration.
  • At least three ship a real workflow without founder intervention.
  • Two remain active or request a paid capability such as shared history, CI, analytics, or evaluations.
  • Two reference integrations and case studies become public.

By the end, we should know which part of Signett developers truly value—exposure, testing, reliable execution, the Inspector, evaluations, or something we have not yet recognized.


You may be a strong fit if you have

  • Six to ten years of experience as a product-oriented full-stack or frontend engineer.
  • Strong TypeScript, React or Next.js, browser API, and Playwright or Cypress experience.
  • Built SDKs, developer tools, browser tooling, API infrastructure, or observability products.
  • Personally helped developers adopt something through documentation, examples, workshops, open-source work, or direct integrations.
  • Enough commercial instinct to find a design partner, lead the conversation, and turn the resulting work into a useful public case study.
  • The judgment and autonomy to make progress without daily direction.
  • Clear writing and demonstration skills in addition to strong engineering ability.

Experience with WebMCP or MCP is helpful but not required. Curiosity and the ability to learn an evolving standard matter more. The WebMCP proposal is public at github.com/webmachinelearning/webmcp.


The anti-sell


Signett has a product, but it does not yet have proven product-market fit. Adoption is the open question, and answering it is the core of this role.


You should not join if:

  • You want a role devoted entirely to writing code handed to you through a roadmap.
  • You expect someone else to find users, conduct interviews, write documentation, or publish the work.
  • You need a large team, established processes, or daily management to be effective.
  • Your experience is primarily managing mature organizations rather than building from ambiguity.
  • Your main strength is developer content without production software behind it.
  • You want to research or train models rather than build browser-based products developers use.
  • The uncertainty of an emerging standard makes you uncomfortable.
  • You need the stability and specialization of a conventional engineering position.

.

This is not a comfortable job with a “founding” title attached to it. It is a chance to take a technically serious, public product and prove—or disprove—that it deserves to become an important company.


How we will start


We begin with a paid four-to-six-week project involving a real external TypeScript application, not a synthetic coding exercise.

The purpose is for both sides to experience the actual work: finding a useful integration, shipping it, learning from developers, and improving Signett. If the collaboration works and the evidence supports continued investment, the intended path is a permanent, full-time role.

The work is fully remote. Compensation, location, time-zone overlap, and the terms of the initial project will be discussed transparently before the process begins.

About i95Dev

i95Dev is an eCommerce and ERP integration company serving 400+ clients globally. We connect platforms like Shopify, Adobe Commerce, and BigCommerce with ERP systems including NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, and SAP. As we scale our AI-driven integration products, we're building modern technology solutions that simplify complex eCommerce and ERP integration challenges.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Product Management Associate to support our product team in researching customer needs, analyzing market trends, documenting product requirements, and supporting the development and improvement of technology products.

This is an entry-level opportunity for fresh graduates interested in product management, technology, business analysis, and customer-centric problem solving.

You will work closely with product, engineering, marketing, sales, and other business teams to understand problems, identify opportunities, and support product initiatives from idea to execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct market and competitor research to understand industry trends and product opportunities
  • Research customer needs, pain points, and use cases
  • Assist in gathering and documenting product requirements
  • Support the preparation of product requirement documents, user stories, feature specifications, and process documentation
  • Work with product managers and engineering teams to track product features and enhancements
  • Assist in maintaining product roadmaps, feature trackers, and product documentation
  • Analyze customer and product feedback to identify improvement opportunities
  • Support product testing and validation of new features before release
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure requirements and product updates are clearly communicated
  • Assist in preparing product presentations, demos, and internal product documentation
  • Track product-related metrics and prepare reports to support decision-making
  • Research emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and industry developments relevant to the company's products
  • Support other product management initiatives based on business requirements

Requirements

  • MBA/PGDM, Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Technology, Engineering, or a related field
  • Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply
  • Strong interest in product management, technology, SaaS, eCommerce, or business analysis
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to understand business problems and translate them into structured requirements
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Good knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and presentation tools
  • Comfortable learning new technology and product management tools
  • Basic understanding of software products or technology concepts is an advantage

Soft Skills & Qualities

  • Strong analytical and logical thinking
  • Curious about technology and how products are built
  • Customer-focused mindset
  • Good attention to detail
  • Strong communication and documentation skills
  • Comfortable asking questions and challenging assumptions
  • Ability to work with multiple teams
  • Self-motivated and willing to learn
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Project Examples

You might work on initiatives such as:

  • Conducting competitor research for an eCommerce integration product
  • Analyzing customer feedback and identifying product improvement opportunities
  • Supporting the creation of product requirement documents
  • Preparing feature comparison and market analysis reports
  • Assisting with testing and validation of new product features
  • Researching potential applications of AI in eCommerce and ERP integration
  • Supporting product documentation and internal product enablement

Work Environment

  • Opportunity to work with global teams across US, Europe, and Australia
  • Exposure to real-world B2B technology and SaaS products
  • Hands-on experience working with product, engineering, sales, and marketing teams
  • Potential for career growth based on performance

i95Dev encourages applications from candidates of diverse backgrounds who are curious about technology, passionate about solving business problems, and interested in building a career in product management.

We’re reimagining how users interact with SaaS products and looking for a founding engineer to help build the first version from zero alongside a founder with experience building at HubSpot, Asana, and Datadog.



Role

We are hiring a Founding Engineer with strong frontend, product, and design instincts. You will work directly with the founder to shape the product, prototype quickly, make architecture decisions, think through user problems, and turn an early thesis into a working product.

The ideal person is a builder — someone who can move from an ambiguous idea to prototype, from prototype to usable product, and from usable product to scalable architecture. You should be excited by the opportunity to change how users interact with software and, eventually, the internet itself.

What You’ll Build

You will help build the first version of our core product, including:

  • An SDK powered by frontier AI models and modern product experience protocols
  • Backend services with rules, resolution logic and intent inference
  • Early prototypes that help us test different wedges with customers
  • Production-ready systems as the product direction becomes clearer

This role will likely span React, TypeScript, Next.js, backend APIs, databases, event tracking, and AI-assisted workflows.

Required Experience

  • 2–5 years of software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability
  • Strong frontend engineering experience with React and TypeScript
  • Ability to design clean, scalable frontend component architecture
  • Experience with backend APIs and databases
  • Experience taking ambiguous product ideas and turning them into working software

Strong Plus

  • Experience building 0-to-1 products
  • Experience at an early-stage startup
  • Experience building SaaS products

What Success Looks Like

In the first 30 days, you will:

  • Understand our thesis, target customer, and product direction
  • Help refine the first product wedge
  • Build and iterate on early prototypes
  • Set up core frontend and backend foundations
  • Move quickly across product, design, and engineering decisions

In the first 60–90 days, you will:

  • Ship the first usable product prototype
  • Help build demo experiences that clearly communicate the product vision
  • Create the first version of the adaptive frontend architecture
  • Help test the product with early users, customers, or design partners
  • Identify what should become production-grade versus what should remain experimental

Leadership Opportunity

This is a founding role with significant upside.

For the right person, strong performance can lead to a leadership position as the company grows. We are looking for someone who can become a long-term technical and product partner — someone who can help build the first version, shape the architecture, hire future engineers, and potentially lead major parts of the engineering organization.

This is an opportunity to join at the earliest stage and help define both the product and the company.

Why Join

  • Build from zero with high ownership
  • Work directly with the founder
  • Help create a new category of software
  • Own meaningful technical decisions from day one
  • Opportunity to join the leadership team as the company scales

About Us


We believe the future of software development is AI-native — where engineers operate at a higher level of abstraction and quality remains non-negotiable. 


Incubyte is a software craft consultancy where the “how” of building software matters as much as the “what”.  


We partner with companies of all sizes, from helping enterprises build, scale, and modernize to early-stage founders bringing their ideas to life. 

Our engineers operate in an AI-native development model, using AI as a collaborator across the SDLC to accelerate development while upholding the discipline of software craftsmanship. Guided by Software Craftsmanship and Extreme Programming practices, we build reliable, maintainable, and scalable systems with speed, without compromising quality. If this way of building software resonates with you, we’d like to talk. 


Our Guiding Principles 


These principles define how we work at Incubyte. They are non-negotiable. 


Relentless Pursuit of Quality with Pragmatism 

  We build high-quality systems without losing sight of delivery. 


Extreme Ownership 

  We take responsibility end-to-end for decisions, execution, and outcomes. 


Proactive Collaboration 

  We collaborate closely, challenge each other, and solve problems together. 


Active Pursuit of Mastery 

  We continuously improve our craft and raise our bar. 

Invite, Give, and Act on Feedback 

We seek, give, and act on feedback to get better every day. 


Ensuring Client Success 

We act as trusted partners and focus on real outcomes, not just output. 


Job Description

This is a remote position.


Our Core Value

  • Client Success: Our clients’ success is our success
  • Extreme Ownership: We own our work and its outcomes fully
  • Proactive Collaboration: Teamwork elevates us all 
  • Quality with Pragmatism: We aim for excellence with a focus on practical solutions
  • Effective Feedback: Honest, constructive feedback fosters improvement
  • Proactive Collaboration: Teamwork elevates us all


Experience Level

​We're looking for a seasoned Product Manager with at least 4 years of experience building user-centric products. You should be a "product craftsperson" who can demonstrate a history of driving tangible, impactful results


Role Overview 

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept to launch and beyond. You'll act as the central hub, working with stakeholders and clients to define product roadmaps and success metrics.

A key part of your role will be to deeply understand customer and business needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements for the development team. You will own the product backlog, analyze performance data to identify opportunities, and partner closely with design and engineering to ensure successful execution


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Execution: You will define and document product requirements, create and maintain a prioritized backlog, and ensure business needs are met throughout the design, development, and delivery phases.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: You will use your strong analytical and problem-solving skills to gather, analyze, and interpret data to prove or disprove hypotheses and guide product evolution. Expertise in Excel and SQL is essential for this.
  • Stakeholder & Client Management: You will communicate with internal and external teams, including clients, to manage expectations, present product status, and gather feedback. Strong consultative, listening, and presentation skills are crucial.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will coordinate with various teams—including design, engineering, sales, and support—to build, manage, and evolve the product. A solid understanding of software engineering concepts will help you drive product strategy effectively



Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Product Mindset: You'll be a central figure, coordinating with various teams to build and support the product
  • Agile Experience: You must have experience working within Agile and Extreme Programming methodologies in a continuous deployment environment
  • Technical Acumen: You should have a solid understanding of software engineering concepts to help drive product strategy
  • Exceptional Communication: You should have strong consultative, listening, and presentation skills to effectively communicate with clients and stakeholders
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: We need someone with a strong ability to understand complex business environments and to dive into data using Excel and SQL to derive meaningful insights.
  • Attention to Detail: You will need to create clear and precise product documentation and assist in the sales and pre-sales process



Benefits

What We Offer 

  • Dedicated Learning & Development Budget: Fuel your growth with a budget dedicated solely to learning.  
  • Conference Talks Sponsorship: Amplify your voice! If you’re speaking at a conference, we’ll fully sponsor and support your talk. 
  • Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on exciting projects with the latest AI technologies   
  • Employee-Friendly Leave Policy: Recharge with ample leave options designed for a healthy work-life balance. 
  • Comprehensive Medical & Term Insurance: Full coverage for you and your family’s peace of mind. 
  • And More: Extra perks to support your well-being and professional growth. 


Work Environment 

  • Remote-First Culture: At Incubyte, we thrive on a culture of structured flexibility — while you have control over where and how you work, everyone commits to a consistent rhythm that supports their team during core working hours for smooth collaboration and timely project delivery. By striking the perfect balance between freedom and responsibility, we enable ourselves to deliver high-quality standards that our customers recognize us by. With asynchronous tools and a push for active participation, we foster a vibrant, hands-on environment where each team member’s engagement and contributions drive impactful results. 
  • Work-In-Person: Twice a year, we come together for two-week sprints to collaborate in person, foster stronger team bonds, and align on goals. Additionally, we host an annual retreat to recharge and connect as a team. All travel expenses are covered. 
  • Proactive Collaboration: Collaboration is central to our work. Through daily pair programming sessions, we focus on mentorship, continuous learning, and shared problem-solving. This hands-on approach keeps us innovative and aligned as a team. 

Incubyte is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
